# Ability check against a DC — SRD 5.2.1

The same template, params and die as `../ability-check-vs-dc-srd-5.1/`, under SRD 5.2.1
(*Playing the Game > D20 Tests > Ability Checks*). The editions word the comparison the same
way — a total equal to the DC succeeds — so this case asserts the identical outcome, and the
pair fails if a pack ever makes them disagree.
